summary: ExoZymes Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to attach an investor presentation being provided to potential underwriters and offering participants for a proposed public offering of securities. No definitive deal terms, board recommendation, advisor names, or structural details are provided. The filing is a routine disclosure of marketing materials and does not trigger any special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring. There is no agreement to merge, sell, or spin off. The registrant is the issuer presenting its business to prospective investors.
